cases.name: Donna Lynn Seiler
cases.about:
Friends described Seiler as a person with "a huge heart" who was "bubbly" and "the life of the party."

https://www.heraldmailmedia.com/story/news/local/2020/08/25/slain-womans-friend-says-we-wanted-her-to-leave/115868298/

Her obituary said, "She was a member of Lansdowne Church of God in Baltimore, MD. Donna was a graduate of Andover High School in Linthicum, MD and earned her Associates Degree in human services. She worked as a project manager/field inspector with RK&K Engineering in Keyser, WV. Donna was active with grief support groups where she volunteered with meetings and was active with Be Kind. She enjoyed crafting, scuba diving, being with her family, especially during the annual holiday cookie exchange and participate in muddy momma’s competitions."

https://www.helsleyjohnsonfh.com/obituary/donna-seiler
